An orchard pays per-tree saffron escrow each harvest. The grower posts escrow equal to one tree's saffron value; the ledger names which tree it covers, and escrows cannot merge across plots.

Each weighed saffron batch must trace to a named tree; a fake tree whose yield sends no ripple in irrigation logs fails traceability and forfeits its escrow.

Attack cost: each invented tree holds its own escrow at full value every harvest - no bulk escrows, no pooling. Cost grows linearly per fake tree; honest growers escrow real trees only.
